label: preparing
what: A secret surprise feast celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, planned for day 1 at eighteen in the town hall great hall: 200 fresh loaves and eight installed lanterns. Builder installed lanterns and hauled bread; baker baked; freight funded, supplied grain and hauled; innkeeper funded, baked, transported and guarded provisions. Neighbour knowingly helped conceal the occasion and arranged to escort the mayor under the description of an ordinary meeting. Repeated counts confirm the provisions were ready. No record shows the mayor being told the true purpose, or the secretary knowingly assisting the surprise.
